settings.headerDescription: Options and permissions for the Starter application, applied across the workspace. Workspaces, members and personal profiles are managed by Comitor.Account.

draft.savedDescription: The change now applies to this workspace.

general.taskDescription: Defaults for the task table and the task form, applied across the workspace.
general.taskHelp: These are pre-filled values, not limits: everyone can still change them on a single task or on a single visit to the table.
general.defaultPriorityDescription: Pre-filled in the new task form; the author can still change it.
general.pageSizeDescription: Page size when the task table opens, applied across the workspace. Anyone can still change it on the table.
general.autoAssignDescription: Applies to everyone in the workspace. The author can still change it before submitting.
general.appearanceDescription: Applies to you only, on this device.
general.themeDescription: Follow the operating system, or pin one mode. Your choice is remembered.
general.contrastDescription: A contrast-measured palette, for bright screens or tired eyes.
general.densityDescription: Reduce the vertical spacing between rows in tables, lists and menus.
general.fontSizeDescription: Scale the whole interface up or down, icons and spacing included.
general.languageDescription: The language of the whole interface on this device. It starts from your Comitor.Account profile and follows changes there until you pick something here.
general.shortcutsDescription: Symbols follow the operating system you are on.

shortcut.save-settings: Save changes on the settings page

notifications.title: Workspace notifications
notifications.description: Whether these Starter application events may be sent at all. Applies to everyone in the workspace — the address they are sent to is yours alone, and it lives in your Comitor.Account profile.

assigned.label: When a task is assigned
assigned.description: Sent as soon as someone assigns a new task or changes the assignee.

due-soon.label: Before a due date
due-soon.description: One day before the due date, to the assignee of tasks that asked for a reminder.

email-digest.label: Group everything into an email digest
email-digest.description: A single email instead of many separate notifications.

notifications.digestDescription: The digest groups every change in the period into one email.
notifications.digestDisabledDescription: This opens up once “Group everything into an email digest” above is on.

digest.weekly: Start of the week, Monday morning
digest.friday: End of the week, Friday afternoon

permissions.accountBody: The four roles below belong to the {workspace} workspace and are granted by Comitor.Account — this application only reads them. The table below decides what each role can do inside the application; it cannot change anyone's role.
permissions.membersLink: Manage members and roles in Comitor.Account
permissions.readOnlyTitle: You can only view this table
permissions.readOnlyDescription: Editing permissions requires the “Change permissions” permission. The table still shows what each role can do inside the application.
permissions.sectionDescription: A checked cell means the role in that column can do the thing in that row.
permissions.help: Two cells never change: the owner always has every permission (removing it locks you out of your own workspace), and a guest never gets a write permission. Hiding a button is not a permission check — the real one runs on the server and reads this very table.

always.label: Always granted
always.reason: The owner always has every permission in the application. Removing one would lock you out of your own workspace.

never.label: Cannot be granted
never.reason: A guest is someone outside the organisation, so they can only read. Write actions cannot be granted to this role.

task_view.label: View tasks
task_view.description: Open the task table and read the detail of a task.

task_create.label: Create tasks
task_create.description: Open the form and create a new task in the workspace.

task_edit.label: Edit tasks
task_edit.description: Change the title, description, status, due date and estimate.

task_assign.label: Assign tasks to others
task_assign.description: Change the assignee of an existing task.

task_delete.label: Delete tasks
task_delete.description: Permanently delete a task, including bulk deletion from the table.

project_view.label: View projects
project_view.description: See the project list and the progress of each project.

project_create.label: Create projects
project_create.description: Open a new project and set its owner.

report_view.label: View reports
report_view.description: The summary figures on Overview and the tasks-per-project chart.

report_export.label: Export data
report_export.description: Download the filtered set of tasks as a CSV file.

app_settings.label: Change application settings
app_settings.description: The General, Notifications and Advanced tabs of this page.

app_permissions.label: Change permissions
app_permissions.description: This table itself — who may edit what other people can do in the application.

advanced.dataDescription: Applies to every task and project this application keeps for the workspace.
advanced.help: These switches only touch the data of the Tasks application. Workspace-wide policy — two-factor authentication, who may invite people — lives in Comitor.Account.

public-link.label: Allow public links to a task
public-link.description: Anyone with the link can read one task without signing in.

activity-log.label: Keep a change log for tasks
activity-log.description: Record who changed what and when — the source of Recent activity on Overview.

advanced.archiveDescription: Archived tasks stay searchable, they just leave the default table.
advanced.dangerDescription: Nothing in this group can be undone.
advanced.resetDescription: Permanently delete {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} and {projects, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}, plus every attachment the Tasks application keeps in this workspace. The workspace, its members and the other applications are untouched.
advanced.dialogDescription: Every task, project and attachment the Tasks application keeps for {workspace} will be deleted permanently. There is no backup and no undo. The workspace and its members stay untouched in Comitor.Account.
advanced.confirmHint: Type {slug} to unlock the delete button

readOnly.title: This page is read-only for you
readOnly.description: Your role in this workspace cannot change application settings. Ask an owner or an admin to make the change.

settings.notYetActive: This value is saved but nothing reads it yet — this sample module has no background job for it.

taskNew.description: Fill in the details to open a new task in this workspace.
taskNew.directoryUnavailableTitle: The member directory is not available
taskNew.directoryUnavailableDescription: The machine-to-machine connection to Comitor.Account is not configured, so the list of people in this workspace cannot be read. The “Assignee” field will be empty and submitting the form will be rejected. Set COMITOR_M2M_CLIENT_ID and COMITOR_M2M_CLIENT_SECRET in .env, then restart the server.
taskNew.sectionContentDescription: The part everyone reads first, in the list and in notifications.
taskNew.sectionAssignmentDescription: Who does it, who follows along, and when it is due.
taskNew.sectionApprovalDescription: Who has to agree first, and how everyone hears about it.
taskNew.codeDescription: Assigned automatically once the task is created.
taskNew.titleDescription: One sentence describing the work, starting with a verb.
taskNew.titlePlaceholder: For example: Review the form's error messages
taskNew.summaryDescription: Updates with every change in the form beside it.
taskNew.summaryPlaceholder: What problem does this solve? How will you know it is done?
taskNew.requestTypeDescription: Decides which queue the work joins.
taskNew.externalDisabledReason: This workspace has external sharing turned off. Turn it on in Settings → Advanced.
taskNew.attachmentAfterCreate: Images are attached after the task exists — a separate step, so a flaky network can be retried without creating a duplicate task.
taskNew.projectDescription: Type the project code or name.
taskNew.projectSearchPlaceholder: Search by project name or code…
taskNew.watchersDescription: They get notified but are not accountable for finishing it.
taskNew.priorityDescription: Decides the order in the queue.
taskNew.dueDateDescription: Type a date or use the calendar button.
taskNew.estimateDescription: Working hours, at most {max} hours for one task.
taskNew.approvalToggleLabel: Needs approval before it is assigned
taskNew.approvalToggleDescription: The task waits in review until an approver agrees.
taskNew.approvalFlowHint: Approvers are notified as soon as the task is created.
taskNew.approvalFlowDisabledHint: Turn on “Needs approval before it is assigned” to pick a flow.

team-lead.label: Team lead approves
team-lead.steps: One step: the assignee's team lead.

two-level.label: Two-level approval
two-level.steps: Two steps: team lead, then department head.

product-board.label: Product board
product-board.steps: Reviewed at the board meeting every Tuesday.

taskNew.channelsDescription: Applies to the assignee and to the watchers.
taskNew.channelNotDeliveredYet: Your choice is saved, but this channel cannot deliver yet — nothing is sent through it.

in-app.label: In the app
in-app.description: Shows up in the notification bell in the header.

email.label: Email
email.description: Sent to the verified address in the Comitor.Account profile.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: Posted to the project channel in the Chat app.

sms.label: SMS
sms.description: For urgent work only — text messages are billed.

taskNew.remindLabel: Remind one day before the deadline
taskNew.remindDescription: Sends a reminder at 9am the day before it is due.
taskNew.calendarDescription: Creates an all-day event on the due date.
taskNew.errorSummaryTitle: {count, plural, one {# item still needs attention} other {# items still need attention}}
taskNew.errorSummaryHint: The fields marked below are missing or not valid yet.
taskNew.errorTitleShort: The title needs at least {min} characters so teammates know what to do.
taskNew.errorProjectRequired: Pick the project this task belongs to.
taskNew.errorAssigneeRequired: Pick an assignee — nobody picks up a task with no owner.
taskNew.errorDueDateRequired: Pick a deadline for this task.
taskNew.errorDueDatePast: That deadline has passed. Pick a date from today onwards.
taskNew.errorEstimateRange: The estimate must be between {min} and {max} hours. Split anything bigger.
taskNew.errorApprovalFlowRequired: Pick an approval flow, or turn approval off.
taskNew.errorChannelsRequired: Pick at least one channel to notify the assignee.
taskNew.draftFilledIn: Its content has been filled back into the form below.
taskNew.draftHint: Save a draft to come back and finish later.
taskNew.draftSavedDescription: The draft is visible only to you, in this workspace.
taskNew.draftRestoredDescription: The form is back to exactly what was saved.
taskNew.noProjectDescription: Every task belongs to a project. Create the first one, then come back here.

taskDetail.attachmentHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. You can also drop a file here.
taskDetail.attachmentFailed: The file could not be uploaded.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Every task in this workspace — filter, sort and act in bulk.
tasks.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, task, project or assignee…

bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# task selected} other {# tasks selected}}
bulk.deleteTitle: {count, plural, one {Delete the selected task?} other {Delete the # selected tasks?}}
bulk.deleteDescription: Deleted tasks cannot be restored, including the comments and attachments inside them.

delete.description: “{title}” will be removed from its project. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.description: Create the first task to start tracking project progress.
empty.filteredDescription: Try removing some filters or clearing the search box.

toast.completedMany: {count, plural, one {# task marked as done.} other {# tasks marked as done.}}
toast.deletedMany: {count, plural, one {# task deleted.} other {# tasks deleted.}}
toast.assignedMany: {count, plural, one {# task assigned.} other {# tasks assigned.}}

projects.description: Group work by goal. Progress is COUNTED from tasks, not stored as a column.
projects.emptyDescription: Every task belongs to a project, so create the first project before opening the first task.
projects.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Your role cannot create projects. Ask an owner or an admin to create one.

aiUsage.description: Paste vendor keys here. Each person gets one internal key to call AI from VS Code or Cursor. The LLM gateway runs on this machine, port 3100.
aiUsage.vendorsHint: Only people with settings access can paste keys. Leave a field empty to keep the current key.
aiUsage.vendorEmptyKeeps: Leave empty to keep this key unchanged.
aiUsage.usersHint: The full key is shown once. After that the table only shows a preview.
aiUsage.usersEmptyHint: Create a key for each person, then give them the port 3100 URL and the internal key.
aiUsage.blockDescription: {name} will not be able to call AI until the key is unblocked.
aiUsage.unblockDescription: {name} will be able to call AI again, within the remaining cap.
aiUsage.logsHint: Estimates from a rough price table. The real invoice is at Anthropic, xAI and Google.
aiUsage.logsEmptyHint: When someone calls AI through port 3100, rows show up here.
aiUsage.modelsHint: Pick these in the Cline, Continue or Cursor Chat model menu.
aiUsage.setupHint: One key for all of it. Claude Code is Claude only; for three vendors use Cline, Continue or Cursor Chat.
aiUsage.setupOpenai: Cline / Continue: Base URL {origin}, API key = internal key, pick the model in chat.
aiUsage.setupCursor: Cursor Chat / Agent: OpenAI API Key = internal key, Override Base URL = {origin}. Cursor Tab and Ctrl+K do not go through this gateway.

accessDenied.whoCanHelpHint: An owner or admin of the workspace. They do it in Comitor.Account, not in this application.
accessDenied.signOut: Sign in with a different account

NOT_A_MEMBER.title: You are not in any workspace yet
NOT_A_MEMBER.description: Tasks runs inside a workspace. Ask an administrator to invite you, or create a workspace of your own.

APP_NOT_ENABLED.title: This workspace has not enabled Tasks
APP_NOT_ENABLED.description: {workspace} has not added Tasks to its plan. An administrator can enable it under Applications and plan.

NO_SEAT.title: You do not have a seat yet
NO_SEAT.description: {workspace} has Tasks enabled, but seats are granted per person. Ask an administrator to give you one.

APP_SUSPENDED.title: Tasks is suspended
APP_SUSPENDED.description: The plan for {workspace} is past due, so Tasks is suspended. Your data is intact and comes back as soon as billing is updated.

signedOut.title: You have signed out of Tasks
signedOut.description: This application's session has ended and its access token was revoked.
signedOut.stillSignedIn: You are still signed in to Comitor.Account
signedOut.stillSignedInHint: It means other Comitor products are still open, and “Sign in again” will go straight through without a password. On a shared computer that is not really signing out — this session is already closed, so finish the job in Account.
signedOut.everywhereTitle: Signed out of every Comitor product
signedOut.everywhereHint: The Comitor.Account session is closed too, so the next sign-in will ask for a password. Other Comitor products open on this computer are signed out as well.

signInFailed.title: Could not sign you in
signInFailed.description: The sign-in flow did not complete. Usually the sign-in link had already been used once, or it expired — reopening it with Back or F5 lands exactly here.
signInFailed.stillFailingHint: Then the trouble is not the link. Open Comitor.Account and check your account; if signing in works there, this is an application configuration error — tell an administrator rather than retrying.
